Caps: cell 455 = d10_v2f_b100k_t380's (D7 d7_t380's 421 + 2 checkpoint margin + 32 tokenize for 100k rows). Screen 85: the screen rebuilds the 100k training items for the lineage check, so screen_fixed_minutes = D1's 15 + 32 more tokenize (10 x 100/24 = 41.7 -> 42 vs D1's 10) = 47, + 25.97 D1 proxy child scoring = 72.97 <= 0.95 x 85 = 80.75 (margin for the v3w readout's prompt lengths). Worst case = (60 + 2 x 742) x 0.0495 = $76.43 (hard cap $90, as d10_v2f_b100k_t380). Expected 671 min = $33.21. Worst case = (60 + 2 x 669) x 0.0495 = $69.20 (hard cap $70). Expected = 560 min = $27.72 (parent arm scored in-job in v2f, as D3). d3_v2f_fast's comment follows. DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED. Mode d3_v2f_fast: job_params_d3_v2f_gold.json with only the cell config changed (m2_first_cell_rwkv7_d3_v2f_fast.json = d3_v2f_gold + the d1_fast flags row_plan min_cost, cont_plan single, compile_blocks; job-2amiy 1.40x step). Caps, data, schedule and worst case are d3_v2f_gold's ($66.03). d3_v2f_gold's comment follows. d3_v2f_gold: d3_r1_gold with template jrt-rwkv-g1-v2f (v2 + dict-instruction fix). d3_r1_gold: D3 on the R1 readout format (cell m2_first_cell_rwkv7_d3_v2f_gold.json). Changes vs job_params.json: cell config (template/layout = C1 format v2), the parent arm is scored in-job in the same format (parent_arm_seed arm_sha256 null, its three context.data entries dropped: the v1 seed's unit spec no longer matches), submit command/key/label. Caps and max_duration unchanged (they already priced parent_g12 + parent_index). DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED. First trained m2 cell (jobs/m2_first_cell/JOB_SPEC.md). Phase order: setup, guard, heldout, parent_g12, parent_index (live rate guard measures the box BEFORE training; jobs.m2_first_cell.reprice re-prices the child evals), cell, evals, report. Caps sized so a box up to 25 % slower than job-tkfaj (prefill and per-call latency) completes every scoring phase (projection <= 95 % of the cap); slower boxes stop before training. Worst case = (build_timeout + attempts x max_duration) x batch rate with attempts = 1 + max(max_restarts, assumed_restart_floor) (jobs/common/costs.py) = (60 + 2 x 637) x 0.0495 = $66.03. build_timeout 60 per the launch lint (L-09: image publish timeouts). Expected minutes: scoring phases at the job-tkfaj probe rates (TOK_S 3,757 at 2,048 tokens, CALL_S 0.117); training at the job-tvuat ADOPT step time (median 8.25 s, ckpt_rows_lean).
